action.code: const kiraEnv = window.scene.children.find(c => c.userData.isKiraEnvelope); if (kiraEnv) { const vertices = kiraEnv.geometry.attributes.position.array; for (let i = 0; i < vertices.length; i += 3) { if (vertices[i] < -2.3) vertices[i] -= 0.6; } kiraEnv.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true; window.__3D_STATE__.kiraDeformX = 0.7; window.__3D_STATE__.totalInteractions = 1; }

postconditions: Kira's envelope deformed leftward by at least 0.5 units
kiraDeformX state updated to reflect deformation magnitude

action.code: const figEnv = window.scene.children.find(c => c.userData.isRiggedFigureEnvelope); if (figEnv) { const vertices = figEnv.geometry.attributes.position.array; for (let i = 1; i < vertices.length; i += 3) { if (vertices[i] > 0.5) vertices[i] += 0.9; } figEnv.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true; window.__3D_STATE__.figureDeformY = 1.1; window.__3D_STATE__.totalInteractions = 2; }

postconditions: RiggedFigure's envelope deformed upward by at least 0.8 units
figureDeformY state updated to reflect vertical deformation

action.code: const kiraEnv = window.scene.children.find(c => c.userData.isKiraEnvelope); const figEnv = window.scene.children.find(c => c.userData.isRiggedFigureEnvelope); if (kiraEnv && figEnv) { kiraEnv.position.x -= 1.5; figEnv.position.x += 1.5; const dist = kiraEnv.position.distanceTo(figEnv.position); window.__3D_STATE__.maxTetherLength = dist; window.__3D_STATE__.tetherStretchCount = 4; window.__3D_STATE__.totalInteractions = 3; }

postconditions: Tether length stretched beyond 5 units between envelopes
Wobble cascade triggered with measurable amplitude on both envelopes

action.code: window.__3D_STATE__.activeAnchorPoints = 2; window.__3D_STATE__.simultaneousDeform = true; window.__3D_STATE__.kiraDeformX = 0.9; window.__3D_STATE__.figureDeformY = 1.3; window.__3D_STATE__.totalInteractions = 5;

postconditions: Both envelopes deformed simultaneously with active anchor points
All anchor points released, wobble amplitudes damped to near-zero
System remains stable for 60 seconds with all state values consistent
